name: excel-echarts
description: Convert native Excel charts (DrawingML in .xlsx) into Apache ECharts options — zero-dependency, Node + browser, with CLI

scripts.build: tsc -p . && esbuild src/index.ts --bundle --format=iife --global-name=ExcelECharts --platform=browser --external:node:* --minify --outfile=dist/excel-echarts.browser.js && esbuild src/index.ts --bundle --format=esm --platform=browser --external:node:* --outfile=dist/excel-echarts.esm.js && esbuild src/runtime-global.ts --bundle --format=iife --platform=browser --minify --outfile=static/x2e-runtime.js && chmod +x dist/cli.js

author: 海口龙华区妙妙鱼传媒工作室 <stormnetwork@163.com>
